headlines.title: Deaf dog is reunited with her owner after the devastating floods in Nepal
headlines.description: A deaf dog named Sweetie was reunited with her owner in Nepal after spending days trapped in her home following the deadly floods. An NBC News team on the ground caught the reunion on video.

headlines.title: The unspoken testimony in the Lindsay Clancy trial
headlines.description: Dozens of witnesses were called over three weeks in the murder trial of Lindsay Clancy to testify about what led up to and followed the killing of her three young children. But one person who didn’t take the stand was Clancy herself. Both the prosecution and defense, however, read extensively from Clancy’s diary entries from the months leading up to the killings in a coastal Massachusetts town in 2023. headlines.title: President Trump announces 'biggest oil deal in world history'
headlines.description: President Trump says the U.S. has entered into a deal with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of oil "at no cost to the American taxpayer." Secretary Marco Rubio also claiming this deal a "huge win for both the American and Venezuelan people."
